alignments.note: Genitive noun rendered of + noun; rule 17 heads on the noun.
Reflexive yourselves is the participle's own helper under rule 7; head on the lexical verb.

Dative article of ἐπιθυμίαις: the case preposition *according to* rides along under rule 21 and the supplied possessive *your* is the article's own under rule 20's second arm, ὑμῶν being already spent on *your ignorance* (rule 76). Rule 20 heads such a unit on the possessive itself, as 2CO.9.13 does. 1PE.1.22 records the identical configuration in this chapter, and 2PE.1.5 writes both arms in one verse. The ASV italicises only *the time of* here, not *your*, so no addition markup bears on this unit.

The ASV expands ἐν into the frame *in the time of*; rule 67 keeps the frame undivided on the expressed preposition. 2CO.8.20 is the exact twin — same preposition, same italicised frame, same following article — and heads on the prepositional word at medium. Rule 67's division is genuinely live for a proper preposition, and 1PE's neighbours do not settle it: Revelation is 2-2 on *by reason of* (REV.9.2, REV.18.19 on the preposition; REV.8.13, REV.13.14 on the noun). Head on the prepositional word with the corpus divided; a head on the supplied *time* is the competing reading.

Rule 20 proper empties the article independently of the frame: ὑμῶν is free and carries *your ignorance*, so nothing is left for τῇ. Rule 67 closes the competing reading a second time, the frame never being split across tokens and its carrier being the expressed preposition; 2CO.8.20 leaves its τῇ unrepresented in this same position.
